reasoning: The teardrop map marker inside a circle is the universal symbol for location, address, or map pin. It fits many common tasks across travel, errands, moving, and admin (updating addresses, pinning spots, sharing coordinates, choosing venues), and is only less distinctive because plain uncircled map pin variants also exist.

pass1.ambiguity: Close duplicate of a standalone map pin icon without the enclosing circle.

distinguishing: Sets a white teardrop map pin in negative space inside a heavy solid black disc, visually reading as a circular badge or button rather than a bare outline pin, though it means the same thing (location/place) as the other two.
